title: CPU-ARC: Agentic Reasoning Caching for on-CPU Reasoning Reuse
title_zh: CPU-ARC：面向CPU端推理复用的智能体推理缓存

paragraphs.en: Abstract. Large language models re-invent the wheel all the time. They conflate task-solving with the execution of the solutions, which forces them to solve every problem from scratch. We show that once a task has been reasoned through, the application of its solution to a new problem instance can be done very efficiently and with little involvement from language models. We introduce agentic reasoning caching, a method for constructing robust CPU-executable agentic reasoning caches (ARCs) from LLM reasoning traces. ARCs show on-par performance with frontier LLMs across a range of difficult mathematical and scientific tasks, are fully explainable, continually trainable, robust to input perturbations, and 16-291x cheaper to invoke than the source model.
paragraphs.zh: 摘要。 大语言模型总是在重复发明轮子。 它们将任务求解与解决方案的执行混为一谈，这迫使它们从零开始解决每一个问题。 我们证明，一旦某项任务已经完成推理，其解决方案在新问题实例上的应用可以非常高效地完成，且语言模型的参与极少。 我们提出智能体推理缓存，这是一种从大语言模型推理轨迹构建稳健的、可由CPU执行的智能体推理缓存（ARC）的方法。 在一系列困难的数学和科学任务中，ARC 的性能与前沿大语言模型相当，具备完全可解释性、可持续训练、对输入扰动稳健，且调用成本比源模型低 16 到 291 倍。

paragraphs.en: AI agents and AI-enabled software more broadly often rely on repetitive queries to LLMs featuring the same instructions and plans but different payloads. The LLMs comprehending the same prompts and subsequently reasoning through their tasks from scratch for each new query often results in a significant amount of work being done repeatedly across separate inference instances.

paragraphs.en: Existing work on SLC falls into two broad categories:
paragraphs.zh: 关于SLC的现有工作大致分为两类：

paragraphs.en: Monolithic caching. Methods such as ephemeral prefix caching [ 1 ] , programmatic conversation caching [ 2 , 3 ] , and semantic query matching [ 4 ] look up transcripts of previous conversations on the basis of input prefix overlaps, programmatically supplied conversation IDs, and semantic similarities between different queries. They store entire conversations and their corresponding intermediate generation states (e.g., KV caches or Mamba hidden states) and aim to re-use the largest possible contiguous portion of the query’s generation states wherever possible. Monolithic caches are usually not robust to even the slightest perturbations of the conversation, and when they are (e.g., when employing semantic similarity search), it is often at the expense of their correctness. Monolithic caches of responses can be inspected to guarantee absolute correctness. They are usually compute-cheap to build, maintain, and use but are memory- and bandwidth-expensive to maintain and use.
paragraphs.zh: 单体缓存。 诸如前缀临时缓存 [1]、程序化对话缓存 [2, 3] 和语义查询匹配 [4] 等方法，分别基于输入前缀的重叠、以程序方式提供的对话 ID，以及不同查询之间的语义相似度，来查找先前对话的记录。 它们存储完整的对话及其对应的中间生成状态（例如 KV 缓存或 Mamba 隐状态），并旨在尽可能复用查询生成状态中最大长度的连续部分。 单体缓存通常对对话中哪怕最轻微的扰动都不具备鲁棒性，而即便具备鲁棒性的场景（例如采用语义相似度搜索时），也往往以牺牲正确性为代价。 响应的单体缓存可以被检查以保证绝对的正确性。 它们在构建、维护和使用上通常计算开销很低，但在维护和使用上内存和带宽开销很高。

paragraphs.en: Modular caching. Instead of storing the entire conversational transcripts and their generation artifacts, modular SLC methods first perform a mechanical form of decomposition of the existing contexts and their generation states or a distillation of the context into critical logical steps [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] . Later, when encountering an apparently similar problem, the decomposed artifacts are re-supplied to the language model to accelerate their reasoning process. Only parts of the response are cached, and even in the case of a perfect cache hit, a full new generation (though accelerated) of the response is still required. This makes their coverage more robust to parametric perturbations of the inputs but makes it impossible to guarantee correctness upon review. Modular caches sometimes offer interpretable insights into the reasoning process of the underlying models. They are considerably more compute-expensive to build and use than monolithic caches but tend to be more memory- and bandwidth-efficient to maintain and use.
paragraphs.zh: 模块化缓存。 模块化 SLC 方法不是存储完整的对话记录及其生成产物，而是首先对现有上下文及其生成状态进行某种机械形式的分解，或将上下文蒸馏为关键的逻辑步骤 [ 5 , 6 , 7 ]。 之后，当遇到明显相似的问题时，分解后的产物会重新提供给语言模型，以加速其推理过程。 只有响应的部分内容会被缓存，即使发生完全的缓存命中，仍需要（尽管是加速的）对响应进行全新的完整生成。 这使得它们的覆盖范围对输入的参数扰动更加鲁棒，但也使得无法保证审查时的正确性。 模块化缓存有时能对底层模型的推理过程提供可解释的洞见。 与整体式缓存相比，它们在构建和使用上需要多得多的计算开销，但在维护和使用上往往更节省内存和带宽。

paragraphs.en: Once a particular problem has been reasoned through and the solution has been found, the execution of the solution – the computation or data manipulation behind the problem – can be performed with little involvement from language models. In other words, the search for a solution can be decoupled from the execution of the solution found.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦某个特定问题经过推理并找到了解决方案，解决方案的执行——即问题背后的计算或数据操作——就可以在很少需要语言模型参与的情况下完成。 换句话说，解决方案的搜索可以与所找到解决方案的执行解耦。

paragraphs.en: Much of LM’s reasoning about a particular problem instance can be reused for a set of problems extending beyond the singleton instance.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型对特定问题实例的大部分推理可以被复用于一组超越单一实例的问题。

paragraphs.en: Leveraging Observation O1 , we choose to convert LM conversation transcripts to code, and allow that code to make use of only small language models to perform semantic similarity search and elementary natural language processing tasks such as value extraction, format conversion, classification, or summarization, and only where needed. Leveraging Observation O2 , we choose to parametrize the code in a way that allows it to be re-used for all problems that are equirational to the problem solved in the original transcript (i.e., can be solved using the same reasoning). Further, we choose to produce code in such a manner that does not rely on fixed variable, parameter, and function names but on their natural language descriptions and examples, thus allowing for a liberal re-use of all logical components of previously cached logic in all semantically equivalent scenarios, no matter how phrased, structured, or parameterized.
paragraphs.zh: 利用观察结果 O1，我们选择将语言模型的对话记录转换为代码，并允许该代码仅在需要时使用小型语言模型来执行语义相似性搜索以及取值提取、格式转换、分类或摘要等基础自然语言处理任务。 利用观察结果 O2，我们选择对代码进行参数化，使其能够被复用于与原始记录中所解决问题等价合理（equirational）的所有问题（即可以用相同的推理来解决的问题）。 此外，我们选择以不依赖固定的变量、参数和函数名称，而依赖其自然语言描述和示例的方式来生成代码，从而允许在所有语义等价的场景中，无论措辞、结构或参数化方式如何，都可以自由复用先前缓存逻辑的所有逻辑组件。

paragraphs.en: Agentic reasoning caching is a hybrid of monolithic and modular SLC because it decomposes the logic of an LLM conversation into a network of modules – semantic functions – that can be re-used individually and also provides their composition into a single function that can be used to solve the problem cached. Because of the semantic functions’ wide parametrization, ARCs are robust to logically valid parametric perturbations of the problem. Since every ARC entry is stored as code, ARCs are fully explainable and correctible upon human or AI inspection. Since ARCs are stored as code using only SLMs, they are cheap to maintain and use since they rely mostly on CPU execution. They are further relatively cheap to build, coming at 12-84x the cost of the original reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体推理缓存（Agentic reasoning caching）是单体式与模块化SLC的混合体，因为它将LLM对话的逻辑分解为一个由模块——即语义函数——组成的网络，这些模块可以被单独复用，同时还能将它们组合成一个用于解决所缓存问题的单一函数。 由于语义函数具有广泛的参数化特性，ARC对问题在逻辑有效的参数扰动下具有鲁棒性。 由于每个ARC条目都以代码形式存储，ARC是完全可解释的，并且可以在人类或AI检查后进行修正。 由于ARC仅使用小型语言模型（SLM）以代码形式存储，其维护和使用成本低廉，因为它们主要依赖CPU执行。 此外，构建它们的成本也相对较低，仅为原始推理成本的12至84倍。

paragraphs.en: Agentic reasoning caching is particularly suitable for agentic systems that repeatedly use the same prompts with variable payloads. In an agentic system, using an ARC can be attempted before forwarding the request to the cloud LLM, allowing for a significant reduction in the latency and cost in the case of a cache hit. Owing to their reliance on simple CPU execution and SLMs, agentic reasoning caches are so resource-efficient that they can be brought to edge devices, reducing the cost further. Figure 1 briefly illustrates the gated use of an agentic reasoning cache in an AI system where the cache re-use is attempted before forwarding the request to the full LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体推理缓存特别适合反复使用相同提示词但负载可变的智能体系统。 在智能体系统中，可以在将请求转发给云端大语言模型之前尝试使用智能体推理缓存（ARC），从而在缓存命中的情况下显著降低延迟和成本。 由于依赖简单的 CPU 执行和小型语言模型（SLM），智能体推理缓存的资源效率非常高，可以部署到边缘设备上，进一步降低成本。 图 1 简要展示了智能体推理缓存在 AI 系统中的门控式使用方式，即在将请求转发给完整大语言模型之前先尝试复用缓存。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation of agentic reasoning caching on a range of challenging mathematical and science benchmarks, including its success rates, correctness, robustness, and cost-saving capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在一系列具有挑战性的数学和科学基准测试上对智能体推理缓存进行评估，包括其成功率、正确性、鲁棒性以及节省成本的能力。

paragraphs.en: A brief discussion of the intended placement and implications of this work.
paragraphs.zh: 简要讨论本工作的预期定位及其影响。

paragraphs.en: Our long-term goal is to bring ARC to real production agents to help lower their cost. In this initial, exploratory work, we deliberately focus on the hardest case: rather than agentic workloads of varied difficulty, we test whether ARCs can match frontier-level model performance on difficult mathematical and scientific benchmarks that are commonly used to measure intelligence. Succeeding at that (as we show we do) indicates that the method is not capped by the ability of models to produce these small ARCs, and that, by extension, the broader class of agentic tasks currently driven by frontier-level models is plausibly cacheable as well.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的长远目标是将 ARC 引入真实生产环境中的智能体，以帮助降低其成本。 在这项初步的探索性工作中，我们刻意聚焦于最困难的情形：与其测试难度各异的各种智能体工作负载，我们检验的是 ARC 能否在最常用于衡量智能的困难数学与科学基准上达到前沿级别模型的性能。 成功做到这一点（正如我们所示），表明该方法并不受限于模型生成这些小型 ARC 的能力，由此推论，目前由前沿级别模型驱动的更广泛类别的智能体任务很可能同样可以被缓存。

paragraphs.en: Agentic reasoning caching is the embodiment of the above assumptions. Implementing Assumption A1 , we ask the builder model to analyze source model conversation transcripts to be cached to find which parts (together with their ranges of validity) of their inputs can be varied without requiring substantive changes to the reasoning. Further implementing Assumption A2 , we ask the builder model to comprehend the source transcript and construct a program that can solve the problem posed in the original query considering the above-found input parts as parameters that can be varied. To ensure maximal robustness and cache coverage, we insist that the program is a rich composition of independently invokable units representing logical steps that constitute the reasoning process, which we call semantic functions. An agentic reasoning cache is then a set of semantic functions combined with a many-to-one map of problem instances to the natural language descriptions of the semantic functions that can solve the respective instances.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体推理缓存是上述假设的具体体现。 为实现假设 A1，我们让构建模型分析待缓存的源模型对话记录，找出其输入中哪些部分（及其有效范围）可以在无需实质性更改推理的情况下进行变化。 为进一步实现假设 A2，我们让构建模型理解源对话记录，并将上述找到的输入部分视为可变化的参数，构建一个能够解决原始查询所提出问题的程序。 为确保最大的稳健性和缓存覆盖率，我们坚持要求该程序是由可独立调用的单元构成的丰富组合，这些单元代表构成推理过程的逻辑步骤，我们将其称为语义函数。 智能体推理缓存由此是一组语义函数，结合一个从问题实例到能够求解相应实例的语义函数的自然语言描述的多对一映射。

sents.en: To ensure maximal robustness and cache coverage, we insist that the program is a rich composition of independently invokable units representing logical steps that constitute the reasoning process, which we call semantic functions.
sents.zh: 为确保最大的稳健性和缓存覆盖率，我们坚持要求该程序是由可独立调用的单元构成的丰富组合，这些单元代表构成推理过程的逻辑步骤，我们将其称为语义函数。

sents.en: An agentic reasoning cache is then a set of semantic functions combined with a many-to-one map of problem instances to the natural language descriptions of the semantic functions that can solve the respective instances.
sents.zh: 智能体推理缓存由此是一组语义函数，结合一个从问题实例到能够求解相应实例的语义函数的自然语言描述的多对一映射。

paragraphs.en: Unlike conventional functions whose inputs, outputs, and callees are referenced by fixed identifiers, semantic functions reference everything by natural-language descriptions and examples. This enables semantic discovery: a caller need not know the callee’s name, only a description of what it does, and a callee need not know the names of its inputs, only their descriptions. This design allows any component of a previously cached computation to be reused in any semantically equivalent scenario regardless of how it is phrased or structured ( Figure 2 ). Further, if a change (such as a generalization introducing new parameter) is made to a dependency semantic function, none of its callers need to be updated. Instead, its new, generalized description will open it to a larger set of callers, again without affecting its past callers as long as the new description semantically entails the old one.
paragraphs.zh: 与传统的输入、输出和被调用者都通过固定标识符引用的函数不同，语义函数通过自然语言描述和示例来引用一切。 这使得语义发现成为可能：调用者无需知道被调用者的名称，只需知道其功能描述；被调用者也无需知道其输入的名称，只需知道它们的描述。 这种设计允许先前缓存的计算的任意组件在任何语义等价的场景中被复用，无论该场景如何措辞或组织（图 2）。 此外，如果对某个依赖的语义函数进行了更改（例如引入新参数的泛化），其调用者都无需更新。 相反，它新的、泛化后的描述将使其对更大的调用者集合开放，同时只要新描述在语义上蕴含旧描述，就不会影响其过去的调用者。

paragraphs.en: Semantic functions are composed into networks through the do() primitive. The do() primitive invokes a semantic function by describing its intention imperatively in natural language and passing parameters annotated by their natural language descriptions. A caller passes described parameter values into do() , which pushes a fresh, isolated memory layer onto the context stack, populates it with the payloads, and dispatches to the callee found by semantic search over the function registry. The callee accesses its inputs via load() and stores its outputs into the same layer. Upon return, the caller retrieves results from the callee’s output dictionary with load(result, query) . This mechanism enables hierarchical decomposition: a root function can delegate to arbitrarily nested sub-functions based on its intention rather than their named identities, with each sub-function operating in its own scope while sharing the underlying context stack. See Figure 5 in Appendix A for a complete cache entry illustrating these primitives on an ideal gas law problem from SciBench.
paragraphs.zh: 语义函数通过 do() 原语组合成网络。 do() 原语通过在自然语言中命令式地描述其意图并传递由其自然语言描述标注的参数来调用一个语义函数。 调用方将描述后的参数值传入 do()，do() 会在上下文栈上压入一个全新的隔离内存层，将负载填充其中，并通过在函数注册表上进行语义搜索找到被调用方并分发调用。 被调用方通过 load() 访问其输入，并将其输出存储到同一个层中。 返回时，调用方通过 load(result, query) 从被调用方的输出字典中检索结果。 这一机制实现了层次化分解：根函数可以根据其意图而非子函数的命名标识，将任务委派给任意嵌套的子函数，每个子函数在自己的作用域内运行，同时共享底层上下文栈。 附录 A 中的图 5 展示了一个完整的缓存条目，以 SciBench 中的理想气体定律问题为例说明这些原语的使用。

paragraphs.en: The Context object maintains a stack of memory layers, each backed by a CPU-powered vector store using a small semantic embedding model. When load() is called, it searches the layers top-down, returning the best match from the most local scope. Each invocation of do() pushes a new layer and pops it upon completion, providing natural scoping that prevents unintended interference between sibling calls.
paragraphs.zh: Context 对象维护一个内存层栈，每一层由基于 CPU 的向量存储支持，使用一个小型语义嵌入模型。 当调用 load() 时，它会自顶向下搜索各个层，从最局部的作用域返回最佳匹配。 每次调用 do() 都会压入一个新层，并在完成后将其弹出，从而提供天然的作用域，防止同级调用之间产生意外的相互干扰。

sents.en: During decomposition, ℬ \mathcal{B} also identifies reusable sub-computations, each representing an operation likely to recur across equirational variants or entirely different queries, and marks them for extraction into standalone semantic functions.
sents.zh: 在分解过程中，ℬ \mathcal{B} 还会识别可复用的子计算——每个子计算代表一种可能在等理性变体或完全不同的查询中重复出现的操作——并将它们标记出来，以便提取为独立的语义函数。

paragraphs.en: Using both the user input and the decomposition as context, ℬ \mathcal{B} identifies the class of problems the query belongs to and determines which parts of the input are the natural input parameters that vary across instances of that class. ℬ \mathcal{B} produces a generic input template q ( ∙ 1 , ∙ 2 , … , ∙ n ) q(\bullet_{1},\bullet_{2},\dotsc,\bullet_{n}) and extracts the concrete value of each parameter from the original input, paired with a descriptive name and format examples. Every recognized parameter must be a basic, self-contained piece of information that the reasoning directly consumes (a number, a name, a formula, a relationship, a list of items, a table, and so on) and never an entire problem description or a multi-sentence narrative. Parameters that are naturally variable-size collections (lists, tuples, tables) are kept as single parameters rather than split into individual elements. The output of this phase is the generic input template q ( ∙ 1 , ∙ 2 , … , ∙ n ) q(\bullet_{1},\bullet_{2},\dotsc,\bullet_{n}) together with a dictionary mapping parameter descriptions to their concrete values in the original instance. The phase concludes with an analysis of the logical validity ranges of the individual parameters.
paragraphs.zh: ℬ \mathcal{B} 同时使用用户输入和任务分解作为上下文，识别该查询所属的问题类别，并确定输入中哪些部分是自然的输入参数，即在该类别的不同实例之间变化的那些部分。ℬ \mathcal{B} 生成一个通用的输入模板 q ( ∙ 1 , ∙ 2 , … , ∙ n ) q(\bullet_{1},\bullet_{2},\dotsc,\bullet_{n}) ，并从原始输入中提取每个参数的具体取值，同时为每个参数配上描述性名称和格式示例。 每个被识别出的参数都必须是推理过程直接使用的基本、自包含的信息片段（一个数字、一个名称、一个公式、一种关系、一个条目列表、一张表格等），绝不能是完整的问题描述或多句叙述。 天然为可变大小集合的参数（列表、元组、表格）应保持为单个参数，而不是拆分成单个元素。 该阶段的输出是通用输入模板 q ( ∙ 1 , ∙ 2 , … , ∙ n ) q(\bullet_{1},\bullet_{2},\dotsc,\bullet_{n}) ，以及一个将参数描述映射到其在原始实例中具体取值的字典。 该阶段以对各个参数的逻辑有效取值范围的分析作为结束。

paragraphs.en: Given the transcript, the decomposition, the recognized parameters, and any tools that were available to 𝒮 \mathcal{S} during the original reasoning, ℬ \mathcal{B} produces a structural plan for the program. The plan specifies which semantic functions to create, their dependency structure, the order in which they should be implemented (bottom-up, so that each function’s dependencies are available before it is written), and which function serves as the root. A configurable granularity setting (fine, medium, or coarse; specified by the cache user) controls how aggressively small operations are merged into larger functions: at the fine end, nearly every decomposition step becomes its own function, while at the coarse end only the major reasoning stages are preserved. The plan is designed for robustness to re-parameterization: it ensures that the resulting program structure does not depend on the specific parameter values o o of the original instance.
paragraphs.zh: 给定转录文本、分解结果、已识别的参数，以及 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 在原始推理过程中可用的任何工具，ℬ \mathcal{B} 为该程序生成一个结构化规划。 该规划指明要创建哪些语义函数、它们的依赖结构、实现它们的顺序（自底向上，使得每个函数的依赖项在编写该函数之前已经可用），以及哪个函数作为根。 可配置的粒度设置（细、中或粗；由缓存用户指定）控制将小操作合并为更大函数的激进程度：在最细的一端，几乎每个分解步骤都成为其自身的函数；而在最粗的一端，只保留主要的推理阶段。 该规划的设计具备对重新参数化的鲁棒性：它确保所得的程序结构不依赖于原始实例的具体参数值 o o。

paragraphs.en: ℬ \mathcal{B} enters an agentic loop in which it iteratively writes candidate semantic functions. A function remains a candidate until it passes all checks and is registered in the cache. It may be rewritten multiple times before it reaches that point.
paragraphs.zh: ℬ \mathcal{B} 进入一个智能体循环，在其中迭代地编写候选语义函数。 一个函数在通过所有检查并注册到缓存之前，始终只是候选函数。 在达到那一步之前，它可能会被重写多次。

sents.zh: ℬ \mathcal{B} 进入一个智能体循环，在其中迭代地编写候选语义函数。

sents.en: A function remains a candidate until it passes all checks and is registered in the cache.
sents.zh: 一个函数在通过所有检查并注册到缓存之前，始终只是候选函数。

sents.zh: 在达到那一步之前，它可能会被重写多次。

paragraphs.en: For each candidate function, ℬ \mathcal{B} first searches the existing registry for semantically equivalent functions and inspects their source code to assess whether they can be reused directly or adapted. It then writes the candidate function body using the runtime primitives described in Section 2.1 . The candidate is validated syntactically and via static analysis of narration quality, checking that narration calls are present and that their number is commensurate with the function’s control-flow complexity. ℬ \mathcal{B} then tests the candidate by dispatching it with the original parameters and comparing its output against the corresponding fragment of the transcript, validated by a judge 𝒥 \mathcal{J} . On success, the function is registered in the cache. On failure, ℬ \mathcal{B} receives structured feedback (error messages, judge critiques, stack traces) and rewrites the candidate accordingly.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个候选函数，ℬ \mathcal{B} 首先在现有注册表中搜索语义等价的函数，并检查其源代码以评估是否可以直接复用或加以适配。 随后，它使用 2.1 节中描述的运行时原语编写候选函数体。 候选函数会经过语法验证以及对叙述质量的静态分析，检查叙述调用是否存在，且其数量与函数的控制流复杂度相称。接着，ℬ \mathcal{B} 通过使用原始参数分发候选函数来进行测试，并将其输出与记录的对应片段进行比较，该片段由裁判 𝒥 \mathcal{J} 验证。 若成功，该函数将被注册到缓存中。 若失败，ℬ \mathcal{B} 会接收结构化反馈（错误消息、裁判批评意见、堆栈跟踪），并据此重写候选函数。

paragraphs.en: Once all individual functions are registered, ℬ \mathcal{B} tests the root function end-to-end in two stages. In the first stage (correctness), the root function is dispatched with the original parameters o o and its output is judged by 𝒥 \mathcal{J} against both the transcript and the golden label. In the second stage (extraction robustness), a real invocation is simulated: 𝒯 \mathcal{T} extracts parameters from the raw user input, the root function is dispatched with the extracted parameters, and the output is judged by 𝒥 \mathcal{J} . This extraction round-trip is repeated N N times to test robustness to variance in the extraction process.
paragraphs.zh: 当所有单个函数注册完毕后，ℬ \mathcal{B} 分两个阶段对根函数进行端到端测试。 第一阶段（正确性），使用原始参数 o o 调度根函数，并由 𝒥 \mathcal{J} 依据对话记录和金标准标签对其输出进行评判。 第二阶段（抽取鲁棒性），模拟一次真实调用：𝒯 \mathcal{T} 从原始用户输入中抽取参数，用抽取出的参数调度根函数，再由 𝒥 \mathcal{J} 对输出进行评判。 该抽取往返过程重复 N N 次，以测试对抽取过程中变化的鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: Once a cache has been constructed, serving a new query q ⁡ ( π ) q(\pi) for π ∈ Π \pi\in\Pi proceeds through four steps.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦缓存被构建完成，为 π ∈ Π \pi\in\Pi 提供新查询 q ⁡ ( π ) q(\pi) 的服务将通过四个步骤进行。

paragraphs.en: Entry-point search. The user input is embedded and compared against the entry-point registry via cosine similarity. If the best result similarity exceeds a configurable threshold, the corresponding root function description is returned. Otherwise, the query is forwarded to the source model 𝒮 \mathcal{S} as a cache miss.
paragraphs.zh: 入口点搜索。 将用户输入进行嵌入，并通过余弦相似度与入口点注册表进行比较。 如果最佳结果的相似度超过可配置的阈值，则返回对应的根函数描述。 否则，该查询将作为缓存未命中转发给源模型 𝒮 \mathcal{S}。

sents.zh: 入口点搜索。

sents.zh: 将用户输入进行嵌入，并通过余弦相似度与入口点注册表进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Parameter value extraction. The extractor LM, built on 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , extracts each expected parameter from the user input. The extractor is parameterized by the parameter descriptions stored alongside the root function during registration, ensuring that the extraction is aligned with the function’s expected inputs.

The full narration trace, accumulated during execution, serves as a human-readable explanation of how the answer was derived. Note that while the narrations produced by semantic functions might eventually end up appearing formulated in a somewhat structured and machine-like manner, it would not be too difficult to employ a small transcription model that would make them sound more human-like if genuinely desired by the end users.

paragraphs.en: A key property of this design is that invocation uses only the target (small) model 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and CPU execution; the expensive source model 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and builder model ℬ \mathcal{B} are required only at construction time. This asymmetry is what makes agentic reasoning caching economical at scale: the one-time construction cost is amortized over arbitrarily many invocations, each of which runs at the cost of a few 𝒯 \mathcal{T} calls and deterministic code execution.

paragraphs.en: Although invocation already replaces 𝒮 \mathcal{S} with the cheaper 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , it still relies on vector-similarity search at every do() and load() call to resolve function names and parameter bindings at runtime. ARCs can be compiled using static resolution by traversing the semantic function network, replacing each do() dispatch with a direct Python function call to the resolved callee, and replacing each load() with a direct dictionary lookup on the caller’s payload, producing a self-contained Python module that requires no embedding engine and no vector store at execution time.

paragraphs.en: The ultimate invocation cost of an agentic reasoning cache with the design as outlined in this section depends to a large extent on the target model 𝒯 \mathcal{T} that executes the cached functions at invocation time. How small can 𝒯 \mathcal{T} be? The precise answer depends on the domain and the operational range of the cache: caches that must handle diverse, open-ended inputs would likely place larger demands on the language model than those that operate over narrower domains. In our experiments, the smallest frontier-lab models: Claude Haiku 4.5, Gemini 3.0 Flash Lite, and GPT 5.4 Nano always sufficed as 𝒯 \mathcal{T} , delivering correct results as a part of ARCs at a fraction of 𝒮 \mathcal{S} ’s cost.

paragraphs.en: The iterative construction process naturally tolerates an imperfect 𝒯 \mathcal{T} : because the builder observes invocation outputs and can adjust the language model calls in semantic functions accordingly, transient errors from a weaker target model are corrected over successive rounds rather than propagated silently. paragraphs.en: To evaluate how well the logic of cache entries aligns with the benchmark ground truth and source model reasoning, we measure two quantities. Firstly, we measure golden label alignment : the fraction of benchmark problems for which the cache produces the correct answer as determined by the benchmark’s golden label. Secondly, we measure transcript answer alignment : the fraction of problems for which LM judges assess the cache’s answer as semantically equivalent to the source model’s answer. The former captures absolute performance; the latter captures fidelity to 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . Close alignment between 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and the cache on both metrics would indicate that the cache faithfully reproduces the source model’s reasoning and as such is a good replacement for the intelligence of the source model on the problems given. A large gap in which the cache underperforms 𝒮 \mathcal{S} against the golden label would signal that the cache construction has lost information. Note that because the source model’s reasoning can be at odds with golden labels at times, looking at both of these measured qualities in conjunction with the source model’s performance on that benchmark allows us to analyze whether the model favors the ground truth golden labels or the source model’s reasoning when building the cache entries.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估缓存条目的逻辑与基准真实标签及源模型推理的契合程度，我们测量两个指标。 首先，我们测量黄金标签对齐度：即缓存给出与基准黄金标签一致的正确答案的基准问题比例。 其次，我们测量转录答案对齐度：即由语言模型裁判判定缓存答案与源模型答案语义等价的问题比例。 前者衡量绝对性能；后者衡量对 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 的忠实度。 如果 𝒮 \mathcal{S} 与缓存在这两个指标上都高度对齐，则表明缓存忠实地再现了源模型的推理，因而在给定问题上能够很好地替代源模型的智能。 如果缓存在黄金标签指标上明显低于 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，出现较大差距，则表明缓存构建过程丢失了信息。 请注意，由于源模型的推理有时可能与黄金标签相悖，将这两个测量指标与源模型在该基准上的表现结合起来分析，可以让我们判断在构建缓存条目时，模型究竟是偏向真实黄金标签，还是偏向源模型的推理。

paragraphs.en: Perturbation testing is applied only to benchmark problems for which the cache already produces the correct answer according to the golden label. paragraphs.en: Combined testing is a two-stage pipeline that applies both perturbation modes in sequence. Stage 1 generates, validates, and evaluates phrasal variants as described above. Stage 2 takes each accepted phrasal variant and applies parametric perturbation, with its own generation, validation, and evaluation done independently of the first stage. paragraphs.en: We observe that cache accuracy (C Acc) matches or exceeds source accuracy (S Acc) on seven of the eight benchmarks. The improvement is most pronounced on the competition mathematics problems of AIME, where the cache achieves 93.3% vs. the source’s 83.3% on AIME ’25 and 96.7% vs. 90.0% on AIME ’26. We attribute this to cases where the source model reasons correctly and its reasoning is therefore used to produce a correct cache entry, but a small computational or logical error in the final steps leads the source model to an imprecise answer, whereas the cache executes the same reasoning as deterministic code and avoids such slips. The sole exception is GSM8K, where the cache (98.0%) trails the source (98.5%) by a narrow margin. Fidelity (the rate at which the cache agrees with the source transcript) is consistently high, exceeding 98% on six of eight benchmarks and reaching 100% on MMLU-Pro. Even where fidelity is lower (AIME ’25 and ’26 at 90.0%), the cache retains the ability to produce golden-correct answers when the transcript answer is itself incorrect.
paragraphs.zh: 我们观察到，在八个基准中有七个，缓存准确率（C Acc）达到或超过了源准确率（S Acc）。 这种提升在 AIME 竞赛数学题上最为显著，缓存达到 93.3%，而源为 83.3%（AIME '25），以及在 AIME '26 上为 96.7% 对 90.0%。 我们将其归因于如下情形：源模型推理正确，其推理因此被用于生成正确的缓存条目，但在最后步骤中的细小计算或逻辑错误使源模型得到不精确的答案，而缓存将同样的推理作为确定性代码执行，从而避免了此类失误。 唯一的例外是 GSM8K，缓存（98.0%）以微弱差距落后于源（98.5%）。 保真度（缓存与源转写一致的比例）始终保持高位，在八个基准中的六个超过 98%，并在 MMLU-Pro 上达到 100%。 即使在保真度较低的情况下（AIME '25 和 '26 为 90.0%），当转写答案本身不正确时，缓存仍能产出金标准正确的答案。

paragraphs.en: We note that builder costs range from 12 × 12\times to 84 × 84\times the source invocation cost. Conversely, the savings multiplier at invocation time ranges from 16 × 16\times to 291 × 291\times , with considerably higher savings on difficult competition mathematics (AIME: 262 262 – 291 × 291\times ) where the source model’s per-query cost is highest. Even on simple benchmarks such as GSM8K, the cache delivers a 16 × 16\times cost reduction per invocation. In absolute terms, cache invocation costs are uniformly low across all benchmarks ($0.0004–$0.0019 per sample), owing to the use of a small finetuned open-source target model. paragraphs.en: The results of Section 3 can be interpreted as follows: at a two-digit cost multiplier increase, the logic behind mathematical and scientific reasoning of language models can be converted into a form that, when invoked, reduces the cost by a two-digit multiplier. It would be prudent to ask what situations benefit the most from this approach and what the forward-looking implications are.
paragraphs.zh: 第3节的结果可以这样解读：在两位数的成本乘数提升下，语言模型的数学与科学推理逻辑可以被转化为一种形式，使其在被调用时将成本降低两位数的倍数。 谨慎起见，我们应当追问哪些情形最能从该方法中获益，以及它具有哪些前瞻性影响。

paragraphs.en: We imagine future caching work in this direction to be placed in agentic systems and AI-enabled software in which the same reasoning or the same set of instructions is frequently applied to varying payloads. Based on our familiarity with the field, such configurations are common in enterprise agentic software and AI-enabled software more broadly. We see value in installing agentic reasoning caches onto endpoints that handle repetitively equi-instructed payloads accumulating usage over hours or weeks, and then applying the methodology outlined in Section 2 to produce a more efficient version of that endpoint, with the presence of a large language model fallback in case the incoming queries are sufficiently novel or the cache invocation results in a failure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们设想未来在这一方向上的缓存工作将被置于智能体系统和 AI 赋能的软件中，在这类系统中，相同的推理或同一组指令经常被应用于不同的负载。 根据我们对该领域的了解，这类配置在企业级智能体软件乃至更广泛的 AI 赋能软件中十分常见。 我们认为，在处理重复接收相同指令负载、使用时间累计长达数小时或数周的端点上部署智能体推理缓存是有价值的，然后运用第 2 节概述的方法生成该端点更高效的版本，并保留一个大语言模型作为后备，以应对传入查询足够新颖或缓存调用失败的情况。

paragraphs.en: Even as currently implemented, agentic reasoning caching can learn continuously: a cache that has been built can be continuously added to without having to rebuild the existing entries from scratch, as would be the case for finetuned language models. Moreover, the agentic reasoning cache can be inspected for correctness and is resolutely cheaper than the use of language models that, while smaller, would still have to be sufficiently large to handle the complex reasoning about the payload.
paragraphs.zh: 即使按照目前的实现方式，智能体推理缓存也可以持续学习：已经构建好的缓存可以在不从头重建现有条目的情况下持续添加内容，而经过微调的语言模型则需要这样做。 此外，智能体推理缓存可以进行正确性检查，并且明显比使用语言模型更省钱，后者即使规模较小，仍必须足够大才能处理对载荷的复杂推理。

paragraphs.en: Going forward, we note that the phenomenon of semantic function reuse, as enabled by the search-based function discovery available during the construction stage ( Section 2.2.1 ) and the natural-language intent-style descriptions of semantic functions and their parameters, enables a great deal of reuse once a cache grows sufficiently large. While the problem of generalizing multiple similar but not identical semantic functions into one coherent, more general semantic function is not addressed by this work, we believe that beyond a certain point agentic reasoning caches could overtake a large proportion of workloads from large language models simply by densely populating the domains of most intense interest by their users while growing at a sublinear rate in proportion to the number of input samples. This would be applicable to domains that do not require a great deal of creativity and are instead focused on the execution of particular instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未来，我们注意到，语义函数复用现象——得益于构建阶段（第2.2.1节）可用的基于搜索的函数发现机制，以及对语义函数及其参数的自然语言意图式描述——一旦缓存增长到足够大，就能实现大量的复用。 虽然将多个相似但不完全相同的语义函数泛化为一个连贯的、更通用的语义函数这一问题并未在本工作中得到解决，但我们认为，超过某个临界点后，智能体推理缓存只需在其用户最感兴趣的领域进行密集填充，同时以与输入样本数量成亚线性比例的速度增长，就可能取代大语言模型的很大一部分工作负载。 这将适用于那些不需要大量创造力、而专注于执行特定指令的领域。

paragraphs.en: It is beyond the scope of this work, but we foresee that applying agentic reasoning caching to post-training data corpora could lead to the development of a new class of models – semantic models – that live above neural models such as SLMs/LLMs and are fully explainable, highly efficient, and continually trainable. In such a configuration, neural models, which currently stand at or near the top of the intelligence stack, become a support layer between hardware and intelligent semantic software – “neuralware.”
paragraphs.zh: 这超出了本工作的范围，但我们预见，将智能体推理缓存应用于训练后数据语料库，可能会催生一类新模型——语义模型——它们位于SLM/LLM等神经模型之上，完全可解释、高效且可持续训练。 在这种架构中，目前处于智能栈顶层或接近顶层的神经模型，将成为硬件与智能语义软件之间的支撑层——“神经件”（neuralware）。

paragraphs.en: The fact that our present work demonstrates that frontier-level intelligence can, on problems of interest, be cached to rely only on a single 1B-parameter model in a phrasally and parametrically robust manner gives us strong hope for the ability to perform the entire class of non-creative intelligence tasks on the edge in the future.

paragraphs.en: This appendix walks through a single benchmark problem end-to-end, showing every artifact the agentic reasoning caching system produces: the original question, the source model’s reasoning transcript, the semantic functions that constitute the cache entry, their compiled form, and the final cache output with its narration trace. The example is an ideal gas law problem from SciBench [ 17 ] (predicting the pressure of ethane) with three semantic functions exercising temperature conversion, pressure unit conversion, and the root ideal-gas-law computation. Both the source model’s answer and the cache output match the golden label ( ≈ 5130 ​ kPa \approx 5130\,\mathrm{kPa} ). This example was selected because it exercises all core mechanisms (parameter extraction via load() , sub-function delegation via do() , result retrieval via load(result, …) , reasoning narration via narrate() , value extraction via extract() , and target-model querying via lm() ) while requiring an LLM call at invocation time to classify the temperature unit, demonstrating that lm() and extract() survive compilation.

paragraphs.en: This appendix details the three-stage pipeline used to produce the finetuned 1B-parameter target model 𝒯 \mathcal{T} discussed in Section 2.2.4 : collecting real invocation logs, augmenting them with synthetic data, and supervised fine-tuning.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录详细介绍了用于生成第 2.2.4 节中讨论的经微调的 1B 参数目标模型 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 的三阶段流程：收集真实调用日志、用合成数据进行增广，以及监督微调。

paragraphs.en: During ordinary cache construction and evaluation runs the system logs every LM call made by semantic functions. Each log record contains the role of the caller (builder, extractor, converter, or target), the full request prompt, and the model’s response. We assign every record a deterministic identifier derived from the experiment name, sample id, perturbation tag, role, and call index to enable deduplication and reproducibility.
paragraphs.zh: 在普通的缓存构建和评估运行期间，系统会记录语义功能所做的每一次语言模型调用。 每条日志记录包含调用者的角色（builder、extractor、converter 或 target）、完整的请求提示词以及模型的响应。 我们为每条记录分配一个确定性标识符，该标识符由实验名称、样本 id、扰动标签、角色和调用索引派生而来，以实现去重和可复现性。

paragraphs.en: After running the evaluation benchmarks described in Section 3 , we harvest roughly 20% of the resulting logs. Only records whose role is relevant to the target model (i.e. the target, extractor, and converter roles) are retained, as the builder and source roles exercise capabilities beyond what 𝒯 \mathcal{T} needs. The filtered records are serialized as a HuggingFace Dataset on disk, forming the seeding dataset for the next stage.
paragraphs.zh: 在运行第 3 节所述的评估基准后，我们收集了约 20% 的结果日志。 只保留与目标模型相关的角色（即目标、提取器和转换器角色）的记录，因为构建器和源角色所涉及的能力超出了 𝒯 \mathcal{T} 所需的范围。 过滤后的记录被序列化为磁盘上的 HuggingFace 数据集，构成下一阶段的种子数据集。

paragraphs.en: A seeding set of a few thousand real invocations is too small to finetune a language model reliably. We therefore amplify it with synthetic variants, targeting a roughly 10 × 10\times expansion.
paragraphs.zh: 数千条真实调用的种子集规模太小，无法可靠地微调语言模型。 因此，我们通过合成变体对其进行扩充，目标是实现大约 10 倍的扩展。

sents.zh: 数千条真实调用的种子集规模太小，无法可靠地微调语言模型。

sents.en: We therefore amplify it with synthetic variants, targeting a roughly 10 × 10\times expansion.
sents.zh: 因此，我们通过合成变体对其进行扩充，目标是实现大约 10 倍的扩展。

paragraphs.en: For each seeding record, we repeatedly prompt the source model 𝒮 \mathcal{S} (Claude Opus 4.5) to generate three synthetic variants at a time, aiming for ten valid variants in total. Each variant is a structurally identical request string that differs only in its payload (i.e., the concrete question, problem statement, or data being processed) while preserving the instructional scaffold verbatim. The prompt wraps the seeding request and its response (for context) in XML tags and instructs the model to emit each variant inside <variant> tags. A regex parser extracts the variants and discards degenerate outputs shorter than ten characters or containing leaked chain-of-thought. Within each round, if fewer than three valid variants are recovered, the generator retries up to twice with an appropriately reduced request count.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每条种子记录，我们反复提示源模型 𝒮 \mathcal{S}（Claude Opus 4.5）一次生成三个合成变体，目标是总共得到十个有效变体。 每个变体都是结构完全相同的请求字符串，仅在载荷（即正在处理的具体问题、问题陈述或数据）上有所不同，同时逐字保留指令性框架。 该提示将种子请求及其响应（作为上下文）包裹在 XML 标签中，并指示模型在 <variant> 标签内输出每个变体。 一个正则表达式解析器提取这些变体，并丢弃长度少于十个字符或包含泄露思维链的退化输出。 在每一轮中，如果恢复的有效变体少于三个，生成器会以适当减少的请求数量重试最多两次。

paragraphs.en: Once all variant requests have been generated, a second pass through the synthetically generated variants fills in the corresponding responses. Each synthetic request is sent to 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and the reply is recorded alongside the request. The full set of synthetic (request, response) pairs is written to batched JSONL files and finally consolidated into a single HuggingFace Dataset .
paragraphs.zh: 在所有变体请求生成完毕后，对合成生成的变体进行第二遍处理，填入对应的响应。 每个合成请求都被发送到 𝒮 \mathcal{S}，回复则与请求一并记录下来。 完整的合成（请求，响应）对集合被写入批量 JSONL 文件，并最终整合为一个 HuggingFace Dataset。

paragraphs.en: The consolidated dataset is used to finetune Llama 3.2 1B [ 8 ] with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) via the trl library’s SFTTrainer . Each training example is formatted as a single-turn conversation: the request becomes a user message and the response an assistant message. Rows with empty completions are discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 整合后的数据集用于通过 trl 库的 SFTTrainer，以监督微调（SFT）方式微调 Llama 3.2 1B [8]。 每个训练样本被格式化为单轮对话：请求成为用户消息，响应成为助手消息。 补全为空的行会被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: Table 11 lists the hyperparameters. Training uses BFloat16 mixed precision, gradient checkpointing for memory efficiency, and the AdamW optimizer. The trainer evaluates validation loss at the end of every epoch and saves a checkpoint; early stopping with a patience of three epochs halts training when validation loss ceases to improve, and the best checkpoint is restored automatically. The final model and tokenizer are saved as a self-contained artifact that can be used on an edge device or served through an inference endpoint.
paragraphs.zh: 表11列出了超参数。 训练使用 BFloat16 混合精度、用于提高内存效率的梯度检查点，以及 AdamW 优化器。 训练器在每个 epoch 结束时评估验证损失并保存检查点；当验证损失不再改善时，早停机制（patience 为三个 epoch）会中止训练，并自动恢复最佳检查点。 最终模型和分词器被保存为自包含的制品，可在边缘设备上使用或通过推理端点提供服务。
